title: Christo's Cutlery
description: Adds knives. HIgh attack, low durability.
body:
# Welcome to Christo's Cutlery!
Here's the basics.

With a stick on the bottom and a single block or ore of your choice (current options are wood, stone, and iron), you can make a Knife!

Knives don't let you cook, sadly.

What they **actually** do, is provide stronger damage then their sword counterpart, but have half the durability of their sword counterpart. Good for emergencies.

That's pretty much it for now.
